tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a public web page (http/https). Returns the image. Private/internal addresses are refused.

tools.name: render_pdf
tools.description: Render a public web page (url) or raw HTML (html) to PDF. A url prints as it looks on a desktop screen and is scrolled through first, so content that loads or appears on scroll is in the PDF. Returns the PDF as an embedded resource.

tools.name: generate_og_image
tools.description: Generate a 1200x630 PNG social card (og:image) from a template and text.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "render_pdf" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Render a public web page (url) or raw HTML (html) to PDF. Returns the PDF as an embedded resource." → after: "Render a public web page (url) or raw HTML (html) to PDF. A url prints as it looks on a desktop screen and is scrolled through first, so content that loads or appears on scroll is in the PDF. Returns the PDF as an embedded resource."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
